note.zh-TW: 「股東權益」為舊稱，照教材顯示並加「舊稱」標記；模板原文寫「統計」，網站顯示「總計」，原字列為別名。
note.en: Shareholders' equity is an older term, shown as the course writes it with an old-name marker; the template uses a wrong word for total, which the site corrects and keeps as an alias.

definition.zh-TW: 負債總額加權益總額。依會計恆等式它一定等於資產總計，兩邊對不上就表示某筆交易記錯了。
definition.en: Total liabilities plus total equity. By the accounting equation it must equal total assets; if the two sides differ, some transaction has been recorded wrongly.
